name: impeccable
description: The design language that makes your AI harness better at design.
one_liner: A design rulebook and set of commands that stops an AI coding assistant from producing the same cliched look (purple gradients, cards-in-cards, Inter font) on every project it builds.
buyer: A solo developer or small product team shipping their own app UI who wants it to look professionally designed without hiring a designer.
business_use_cases: An indie SaaS builder runs `/impeccable polish` before every launch so the product doesn't look like an obvious AI-generated clone of every other SaaS site.
A freelance developer uses `/impeccable audit` and `/impeccable critique` as a built-in design-review step they can bill clients for.
A small agency standardizes every project on Impeccable so client deliverables have a consistent, non-generic design quality bar.

money_ideas.idea: Offer a paid 'design doctor' service: run the audit and critique commands against a client's existing app and deliver a prioritized fix list.
Build and sell premium theme/template packs that plug into the same command system for specific niches (fintech, healthtech, etc.).

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'AI design audit' for indie founders: run `/impeccable audit` + `/impeccable critique` on their live app and send back a short punch list within 24 hours.
